children: , Ltd. (Taiwan OTC: 4966.TWO), a leading high-speed interface, video display, touch controllers and Linear Redriver supplier, would like to announce in cooperation with

- a leading cable manufacturer - the successful deployment of Parade Ultra Linear Redrivers (LRDs) in an OSFP (Octal Small Form Factor Pluggable) for inclusion on the June 2026 PF43s InfiniBand Trade Association Integrators List at both XDR (224Gbps) and NDR (112Gbps) data rates.

“Such lists ensure seamless operation with key AI servers, XPUs and switches,” says Jimmy Chiu, Executive VP of Marketing at Parade Technologies. “OEMs can now feel confident employing Parade LRDs in copper cable solutions from 2 to 4 meters to reducing power, latency and rack weight, as well as improved rack routing.”

“Parade Ultra Ethernet series of linear redrivers are capable of supporting latest 802.3dj ethernet specification as well as InfiniBand, UALink, NVLink and OIF standards and extends our commitment to enabling the short reach, high-performance, AI scaleup market with low power, low latency solutions,” Jimmy Chiu further added.
Parade offers a family of PAM4 Ethernet/InfiniBand Ultra Linear redrivers at 56G (EDR), 112G (NDR) and 224G (XDR) cable line rates, as well as a line of PCIe linear redriver solutions.
For Ultra Ethernet/IB Linear Redriver solutions and availability, Contact Parade Sales.

Parade Technologies, Ltd. Is a leading supplier of mixed-signal Ics for a variety of increasingly used high-speed and display interface standards used in network and storage systems, computers, automotive, consumer electronics, and display panels. Parade is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2005 and publicly listed on

(TPEx) in 2011 (stock code: 4966). Parade’s portfolio of signal conditioning IC products serves the growing demand for high speed data integrity solutions for HDMI™, DisplayPort™, USB, PCI Express interface, and Ethernet/IB applications.

Parade leverages its close relationships with market leading Tier-1 OEMs to develop Ics that enable competitive system capabilities. Parade is also a key contributor to industry standards development organizations. The company’s devices integrate proprietary technologies that offer superior signal integrity as well as improved system integration and power efficiency. As a result of the company’s “standards-plus” design philosophy, Parade Ics have been designed into products offered by nearly every leading computer and display vendor worldwide.
